segments.say: Chess rule number six. The queen gives check, right next to White's king. Can the king just take it?
segments.caption: Take the queen?

segments.say: No! The rook protects the queen, and a king can never capture into check. King f1 is the only legal move.
Did you know this? Rule number 7 drops tomorrow. Subscribe so you don't miss it.
segments.caption: Rule #7 tomorrow!
